name: La Janais — canonical site geometry
note: Brownfield extent of the former Citroën/PSA/Stellantis plant at Chartres-de-Bretagne (Rennes Métropole). The boundary polygon is the OSM-derived convex hull of the large industrial halls on the plant (edge-length-weighted modal grid bearing 17.5° from North), extracted by the website repo's scripts/process_site.py. The cadastral parcel set was NOT available as parcel polygons in the source repo (its parcels.geojson is a 50k-point heat-eligibility dataset, not cadastre), so this hull is the canonical site extent every adapter queries against. INSEE commune resolved via BAN = 35066 (Chartres-de-Bretagne).

properties.source: datacenter-community-app/public/data/site_buildings.geojson (kind=boundary), via scripts/process_site.py over OSM Overpass buildings
